name: Berlin
summary: Berlin is an affordable capital by Western European standards, with a growing tech scene and a well-developed cafe and coworking infrastructure. It combines intense nightlife and cultural life with urban lakes where you can swim in the summer, although it does not have a beach. Its public transportation system effectively connects all neighborhoods, and its international community of freelancers is one of the largest in Europe.
